Priya (Recruiter): FYI — candidate wants to move start up 2 weeks because their work permit cleared earlier than expected. Offer ID `OF-2026-449`. Currently set to start 2026-05-18. Requesting 2026-05-04.
Aisha (People Ops): Quick Qs — is comp band already accepted? sign-on included? relocation?
Priya (Recruiter): Comp band is L3-SrEng (matched to guideline B). Sign-on: one-time relocation stipend included. Candidate asked if benefits can kick in from earlier start — they sign final docs tonight.
Jordan (Hiring Manager): I'm supportive of earlier start. Team ramp plans adjusted already. No additional headcount costs.
Miguel (Finance): If start moves earlier, payroll and benefits prorate needs checking. Which payroll region is this (US vs UK)?
Priya (Recruiter): US payroll. Candidate is coming from EAD -> now has valid EAD work authorization, so no visa sponsorship delay.
Aisha (People Ops): Ok — two things we need: (1) comp-band exception? Not really an exception but we need compensation committee FYI since early onboarding affects sign-on timing. (2) Benefits eligibility date: benefits usually start first of month after 30 days or on start date depending on plan. I'll check vendor.
Aisha (People Ops): Routing plan: I'll send an expedited FYI to comp-committee, confirm benefits vendor cutoff, and log request for payroll team. Can someone add the candidate's full name + offer pdf?
Priya (Recruiter): Name: Samir Patel. Offer PDF link: https://files.redwood/recruits/OF-2026-449.pdf. Signed scanned copy incoming tonight.
LegalBot: Note: no additional I-9 steps required beyond standard. EAD documented = cleared. Upload to HRIS after signed offer.
Miguel (Finance): If benefits effective earlier, monthly premium split may change. I'll need orgcode and hire date change submit by EOD to make payroll delta minimal. Orgcode: ENG-PROD-03.
Jordan (Hiring Manager): I'll approve orgcode change and fill the short onboarding checklist.
Aisha (People Ops): Comp-committee routing: tagging @comp-committee. Request: approve early onboarding (2026-05-04) and confirm sign-on payment timing (pay out on first payroll after start). Rationale: candidate cleared EAD early, business needs immediate ramp.
Aisha (People Ops): Attachments: offer id `OF-2026-449`, candidate email thread, signed offer when available. Approvers: @Priya (Recruiter), @Jordan (Hiring Manager) already in thread, + @CompChair and @FinanceOps (Miguel).
Priya (Recruiter): pinging @CompChair — can we get a quick thumbs? Candidate accepted verbally and prefers sooner start.
CompChair (via LegalBot): Thumbs up pending benefits vendor confirmation. Confirm that sign-on payout policy followed (one-time stipend OK).
Aisha (People Ops): Benefits vendor confirmed: benefits active from hire date as long as enrollment completed within 14 days. Payroll confirmed proration automatic.
Miguel (Finance): Confirmed — payroll will prorate based on start date. No additional approvals needed for stipend. Need final signed offer by EOD to schedule.
Jordan (Hiring Manager): Signed offer uploaded. Confirmed start 2026-05-04. Team onboarding slot reserved 05/04 & 05/05.
Aisha (People Ops): Routing complete — comp-committee noted, Finance and Payroll notified, benefits enrollment instructions sent to candidate. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
LegalBot: Workflow: comp-committee FYI recorded (ticket HR-7261). Payroll change ticket PR-3329 created.
